VsCodeExtensionSettings.description: Download the package and install it from the editor. Re-running either path always pulls the latest version.
steps: Open the Extensions view, then its “…” menu.
Choose “Install from VSIX…” and pick the downloaded file.
Reload or restart the editor to activate it.

AttachLocalAgentButton.dialogDescription: Pick the agent you are running, then copy its attach command and paste it into that agent in the relevant repo. It joins as a sub-agent of the same kind and handles its own login.
AttachLocalAgentButton.commandInstructions: Copy and paste this command into the relevant agent in the relevant repo. It joins as a sub-agent of the same kind and handles its own login.
